items.text: Relapsed follicular lymphoma: 2026 EHA guideline placements added to the trial cards (R2 with tafasitamab or epcoritamab from first relapse; bispecifics, CAR-T and zanubrutinib-obinutuzumab after second relapse).
Relapsed myeloma: two new phase 3 trials, teclistamab alone (MajesTEC-9) and talquetamab-daratumumab with or without pomalidomide (MonumenTAL-3), both improving PFS at early relapse.
New on newly diagnosed myeloma: a Prognosis tab with risk models, biomarkers and MRD measures (9 new entries, linked to the trials that used them) and Markers to watch.
Phase 2 trials from leading journals, or that led to approvals, added across all topics (20 new cards); Trials to watch now also lists phase 2 trials designed to support an approval.
New on every topic: a Drug mechanisms tab explaining how each drug class works, with a recent review and links to the trials that tested it.
Relapsed myeloma adds two 2026 phase 3 trials: SUCCESSOR-2 (mezigdomide) and EXCALIBER-RRMM (iberdomide).
